If your order has already been processed or despatched: The quickest option is to place a new order with a faster delivery service and return the original when it arrives.

What should I do if the tracking never updates?
I understand it’s frustrating when tracking does not update. Here’s what to do:
Allow up to 24 hours after your despatch email for the tracking to start showing scans.
Open the ‘track order’ link in your shipping confirmation again to refresh it, or log in to your account, select the person icon, then Order history to view the latest status.
If your order status shows “Processed”, it has been fulfilled but not yet despatched, so tracking will not update until it leaves us.

UK Click & Collect: ready the next working day after despatch
If your expected window has passed with no movement, tell me which delivery option you selected and when your despatch email arrived, and I will advise the next step.
